children: OBTAINS APPROVAL OF QFMA TO PROCEED WITH AN OFFERING OF 40% OF ITS SHARE CAPITAL FOR PUBLIC SUBSCRIPTION
OFFER PRICE OF QAR 5.00 PER SHARE (QAR 5.01 PER SHARE INCLUDING OFFERING AND LISTING FEES)
PUBLIC SUBSCRIPTION PERIOD WILL RUN FROM 7 OCTOBER 2026 TO 20 OCTOBER 2026
FOLLOWING COMPLETION OF IPO, FOUNDING SHAREHOLDER WILL RETAIN 60% OF COMPANY'S ISSUED AND FULLY PAID-UP SHARE CAPITAL
